list.name: Changes
list.comment:
Refactored from the update_Q function up
However, might be learning now, not sure yet

task.summary:
Imported current libraries needed
Defined a click function
Made a simple loop to click all squares of a 9x9 board

Now clicks randomly on the 9x9 gameboard
Took 4406 trys to complete its first game

Refactored the modularity of the solution
Solving, clicking, and end game functions are now defined first, then used in main

Created function to define the game board
This function checks over each block and detects its value: Unsolved, solved, 1, 2, 3, ..., 8

Game board is now saved in a 2d array
Added function to display this 2d array

Renamed functions
Started creating functions to give the AI the rules of minesweeper
Firstly, how to flag bombs, next, working on clicking unknown cells when the number of flags in the 3x3 around a cell is equal to the number in the center cell

Fixed flagging (again)
Redid the logic as to make it so the AI will create a 2d array of the game board --> Check for flags --> Click solved cells --> repeat
As mentioned above, added a function to click solved cells (value == amount of flags in the 3x3 area)

Changed a lot of functions to now take a single screenshot and use "image.getpixel" rather than move the cursor to a certain position to check (wish i had know this earlier)
Saves quite a lot of time, AI is now averaging ~7 seconds
Moreover, refactored the grid definition function to create the grid cell by cell rather than create a 9x9 grid and fill it
Updated all click functions to uses my prebuilt ones (accidently used pyautogui's click functions 2 times)

Updated all click Started refactoring the program into a reinforcement learning algorithm --> Q-learning
Added functions for reseting the game board, finding a new state of a game board, and choosing a random action (temp)
Started implementing a preform action function

Added functions to preform the selected action (random atm), check action for reward, and a step function to actually call these functions and move the AI forward
Starting to implement a function to update the Q value of the AI, this one will be the actual brain of the AI

Refactored from the update_Q function up
However, might be learning now, not sure yet
